definitions.explanation: The quality of being convenient or easily accessible. Often used when evaluating locations, services, or systems.

examples.japanese: {利便性|りべんせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧。

examples.english: It's near the station, so the accessibility is good.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦アプリ→アプリ：04722_apuri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{利便性|りべんせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{追求|ついきゅう}→追求：14401_tsuikyuu⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{設計|せっけい}→設計：03300_sekkei⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This app was designed with a focus on convenience.

notes:
FORMS:
{利便|りべん} (convenience) + ⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧ (quality, nature)

USAGE:
A somewhat formal word frequently used in real estate descriptions, product reviews, urban planning, and business contexts. Unlike the more casual ⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧ (convenient), {利便性|りべんせい} treats convenience as a measurable quality or attribute.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧: convenient (everyday adjective)
- {利便性|りべんせい}: convenience as a quality (more formal/analytical)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {利便性|りべんせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧/⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧: high/low convenience
- {利便性|りべんせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{向上|こうじょう}させる: to improve convenience
- {利便性|りべんせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{追求|ついきゅう}→追求：14401_tsuikyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to pursue convenience
- ⟦{交通|こうつう}→交通：01584_koutsuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{利便性|りべんせい}: transportation convenience
